title: Research consolidation: bind and independently replay the historical prime-subset ceiling (no new kappa)
body:
This contribution closes a provenance gap in the historical common-subset prime-power certificate and independently corroborates its scoped exclusion of kappa >= 2^-26. No new construction or kappa improvement is claimed.

The historical certificate pins four of sixteen local producer modules, plus its explanatory note. This additive package binds forty inputs and reproduces every original certificate field in an isolated directory. A controlled mutation of the unpinned serializer preserves all five historical source digests and the producer's success marker while shifting the emitted target by exactly one. This demonstrates incomplete output provenance, not a mathematical counterexample or corruption of the committed evidence.

A separate implementation uses exact rational harmonic-sum bounds rather than the producer's logarithm routine. It checks 662 finite cases and closes every h >= 67 by a written monotonicity argument.

### Pins and scope

- Exact base: `407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515`.
- Upstream source: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`.
- OS-random assignment seed: 98; research consolidation.
- Eight additions under `research/prime-subset-reconciliation/`.
- Original certificates, selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

The historical incidence, partial-output representation, rank ledger and `kappa < a_b/5` assembly remain inherited hypotheses. This is not a ceiling on later assemblies or a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem.

### Reproduction

Python 3.11+; standard library only:

```sh
python3 -I -S -B research/prime-subset-reconciliation/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PRIME_SUBSET_RECONCILIATION 626 historical cases; 662 harmonic cases; tail h>=67; complete replay equal; no new kappa
```

### Validation

- Normal and optimized verifier execution passed.
- Six new test methods covering 19 rejection cases passed normally and under optimization.
- All three original family tests passed.
- Selected-record integrity and forty exact-base Git object bindings passed.
- Receipt-tamper rejection, clean patch application, relocated replay and whitespace checks passed.
- Full `make verify`, selected-supplier cold replay, Lean and hosted Linux CI were not run.

### Attribution and overlap

Douglas R. Colkitt's original mathematics and woklerx's PR970 source-binding and isolated-replay pattern are credited.

Concurrent PR996 compares historical and balanced assembly ceilings. This package adds complete producer binding, a serialization-corruption control and an independent harmonic method. No PR996 code or balanced-assembly claim is imported.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical reasoning, implementation, controls and documentation. No independent human peer review is claimed. Apache-2.0; predecessor notices are retained.
